task: v_recheck R14-RC-A (I-106 FT secondary + public primary vs exp72 '0/5' prior) - skeptic, value + feasibility
reason:
The count correction is right, but the headline and the proposed replacement text overcorrect.

WHAT CHECKS OUT:
- '0/5' mixes 2-3 primary swaps with 3 secondary swaps.
- All 3 secondary swaps ran on an exp03B primary: probes 7 and 10 on the exp06 base, probe 13 (exp32) on the exp30 base (RESULTS l.37-47).
- exp08 had no diversity, and friend A's ep21 model was weaker.
- CONTEXT l.316-318 does say that 'exp23 with the PILKWANG primary is untested'.
- x138's primary is the public support-pack-50ep model, so exp72's configuration was never tested.

WHAT IS WRONG:
(1) 'The exp72 prior rests on ONE confounded precedent' is false. The primary swaps are the only LB evidence of OUR fine-tuned weights running next to a PUBLIC counterpart model. That is the 'diverse' pairing the finding calls untested, with the roles swapped. Two of them are clean one-change probes on the public stack: probe 15 exp33 (primary := exp03B, public seed314159 secondary kept) -0.003, and probe 17 soup -0.004. Probe 11 adds a confounded -0.003. So our FT weights went 0/3 on the LB even in the diverse pairing.
(2) R13-RC-A shows these losses are not a pure node-count effect either: the soup scored BELOW exp33 despite fewer nodes. So the primary swaps cannot be set aside as 'a different, gated mechanism'. They are direct evidence that weights fine-tuned on our 183-199 videos lose on the hidden embryo.
(3) 'Correlated errors' was an untested 11 Sep hypothesis. Friend B's calibrated port (RESULTS l.101) has exp32 vs exp30 at -0.011 on ALL 12 and -0.020 on CLEAN 6, while exp30 beat exp29 on CLEAN 6. That fits the correlation story and 'exp23 is itself worse as a secondary' equally well. exp29 + exp23 was never run, so nothing separates the two.
(4) The proposed Q1 wording, 'the other 0/5 items are primary swaps or weaker models', would remove real negative evidence from the user's decision text. That is a slant toward yes, not a correction.
(5) Minor points:
- The Q1 text in R13-A3 does not contain '0/5'. It appears in the 21:21Z caveats and in the v_retrain no_go list, so the edit belongs in the evidence line of the push.
- By the finding's own account, no number moves (v_retrain P(<0.954) 25-30%, E ~0).
- exp72 is class C unless Q3 = yes, so the private/finals value is zero.

The genuinely new and valid content:
- the exact exp72 class (a distilled FT secondary with the public primary on x138) is untested;
- the recipe is gentler: teacher-distilled, lr 1e-5, last decoder block + heads, BN frozen, versus exp23's lr 5e-5 all-layer BCE;
- x138 z-aligns the secondary logits.
These shrink both the harm and the gain toward 0. They do not revive a positive prior.

FEASIBILITY: a text edit only. There is no build or slot, and no conflict with R1-R10. G2 veto, class C and 'no push without an explicit yes' are kept.
fix:

- FT primary with the public secondary: -0.003 (exp33, one change) and -0.003 (exp30).
